_comment: Source URLs for this skill's reference files. Run scripts/update-references.py to refresh. references/*.md cover V1; references/v2/*.md cover native V2.

references/providers.md.covers: V1: provider config, model syntax, authentication, Anthropic/OpenAI/Bedrock/Vertex/Ollama setup, apiKey format, provider options

references/mcp.md.covers: V1: mcp config structure, local/remote transport types, OAuth, environment variables, CLI commands

references/agents.md.covers: V1: built-in agents (build/plan/general/explore/scout), custom agent fields, markdown file format, bash glob permissions

references/permissions.md.covers: V1: permission actions (ask/allow/deny), all tool types, bash glob patterns, defaults, global vs per-agent permissions

references/tui.md.covers: V1: tui.json structure, all keybind actions, theme configuration, mouse/scroll/diff/cursor/attention settings

references/config-schema.md.covers: V1: full opencode.json schema — top-level fields, server, commands, instructions, formatters, LSP, compaction, skills, plugins, policies, watcher, managed settings

references/v2/config-schema.md.covers: V2: config locations/precedence (system directory, macOS managed preferences), all top-level fields, ignored V1 fields, commands, skills, formatters, compaction (percentage buffer), media, websearch, warming, references, worktree, instructions (loaded), variable substitution, experimental settings, service env, background service and remote pairing, V2 release notes (CHANGELOG.md), pinned v2.2.5 config schema source (top-level `timezone`, experimental keys)

references/v2/permissions.md.covers: V2: ordered permissions rules, actions/resources, defaults (external_directory allowed), approvals, policies (provider.use, tool.use, integration.connect, integration.use, mcp.use, skill.use, plugin.use; experimental.policies is the deprecated location), policy precedence

references/v2/agents.md.covers: V2: built-in agents, agents map and markdown format, fields (system, permissions, request, disabled), default agent, subagent control

references/v2/mcp.md.covers: V2: mcp.servers, local/remote fields, snake_case OAuth and client registration (pre-registered, CIMD, DCR), timeout object, protocol, Code Mode, resources, server instructions, input requests, tool naming, CLI

references/v2/providers.md.covers: V2: providers map, packages, settings/headers/body, models and variants array, capabilities.reasoning, compatibility and prompt caching, request encoding, model references, ChatGPT sign-in and Claude Agent, Bedrock/Vertex/Azure/Copilot/local runtimes, credential storage

references/v2/cli.md.covers: V2: global cli.json settings, keybind IDs, theme selection and V2 theme format, CLI-only plugins, tui.json migration

references/v2/plugins.md.covers: V2: plugins config and discovery (directory-only local paths), enable/disable directives, plugin CLI, desktop (GUI) plugins, Plugin.define API, V1 hook mapping

references/v2/migration.md.covers: V1 to V2: breaking changes, mixing rules, field renames for permissions/agents/commands/MCP/compaction/providers/models, file locations, server authentication
